answer: Random peer audit is a bridge: each epoch, three random auditors check its work in the river. Each identity first cracks a walnut, a puzzle salted with its key costing 2 POA, so fakes can't share a shell. Proving a copy earns half the fake's 25 POA bond; a false accuser loses its own. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 25,000 POA in bonds plus 2,000 POA in walnuts; three random eyes catch copies. An honest agent pays once and earns a bounty per fake.
